messages:
maria: FYI — Acme reports production customers seeing Trace UI entries with no spans for some request IDs. They say ingest shows span payloads but Trace view displays only request metadata. Example request ids: req_8f4c2a, req_b17f9d, req_c3e7b0. Occurring on Dedicated us-west1. High severity for them.

maria: Repro steps from their ticket: 1) trigger backend job via API 2) copy request-id header from response 3) Console > Traces > search request-id -> trace appears but 0 spans 4) checked raw ingest logs in S3 -> span lines present for same request-id.

maria: Attached a redacted ingest snippet:
```
{"request_id":"req_8f4c2a","span_id":"s_01","parent_id":null,"service":"ingest-proxy","operation":"start"}
{"request_id":"req_8f4c2a","span_id":"s_02","parent_id":"s_01","service":"worker","operation":"doWork"}
```

support-bot: New support ticket created: TKT-4321 (linked). :ticket:

omar: looping in eng-runtime and eng-sre. Any recent changes to span ingestion or the trace joiner? I'll check consumer lag and indexer errors.

kevin: there was a deploy yesterday to span-normalizer (PR #2897) that added an optional header rewrite for `x-request-id` when `x-rw-trace` is present. Could be a header rename bug. I'll pull normalizer logs.

sasha: tagging eng-platform — did we roll out a config that drops large headers last week? Could be stripping parent refs on big payloads.

maria: Acme timeline: first seen ~2028-04-27 09:43 UTC. Console shows trace entries at same timestamps but child spans missing. Screenshot saved in ticket: "Trace 0 spans — request metadata only."

kevin: ran a quick ClickHouse query against spans table for req_8f4c2a:
```
SELECT span_id, parent_id, service FROM spans WHERE request_id='req_8f4c2a'
-- returned 2 rows with parent_id values
```
Spans exist in storage, so UI/trace-joiner isn't linking them.

omar: kafka consumer lag check:
```
topic: spans.v1  partitions: 12  consumer-group: trace-indexer
lag: partition 3 -> 12000, partition 7 -> 0, others <100
```
Indexer logs show repeated parsing errors around offsets 340000-350000.

kevin: parsing errors seem tied to a header rename — normalizer emitted `request-id` (no `x-` prefix) when JAXB path executed. Indexer expects `x-request-id`. If join key missing, spans could be stored but not linked to request row.

sasha: that behavior would produce exactly what customer sees: request row created, spans ingested but join column empty -> UI shows request with no child spans.

omar: plan: pause trace-indexer consumer for partitions with errors, fix indexer join logic, and backfill affected offsets. I'll coordinate with infra to pause consumers.

maria: can someone reproduce locally with a sample message? I can paste a sanitized payload.

kevin: please paste one raw message that shows the wrong header so I can run it through normalizer locally.

maria: pasted sample above — the normalizer output shows `request-id` key in metadata.

kevin: confirmed locally: normalizer produced `request-id` when JAXB path triggered. Implementing a small change to prefer `x-request-id` canonical key if present. Opening hotfix PR.

omar: while kevin lands hotfix, I'll prepare a reindex job for offsets 340000-350000 and run the joiner again; will throttle to avoid cluster overload. Also adding a one-off reconcile script to attach spans for affected request_ids.

elaine: CS: please prepare a short, non-technical note for Acme explaining root cause and ETA. They asked for hourly updates.

maria: sending initial note: acknowledging bug, ETA ~3h to patch and begin backfill, hourly updates. :white_check_mark:

kevin: PR #2901 created with tests. Will smoke test in staging and then merge to prod in ~10m.

omar: paused trace-indexer consumer for partition [3], started reindexer in dry-run for offsets 340000-350000. Dry run shows ~2.3k messages missing the join key.

sasha: scheduling a temporary UI fallback to match both `request-id` and `x-request-id` while backfill runs to reduce impact on customers.

maria: Acme notified. They appreciate the fast response and asked to be pinged when backfill is complete.

kevin: hotfix deployed to normalizer-prod. Metric `normalizer.request_id_fallbacks` spiked then dropped to zero.

omar: reindex job started for offsets 340000-350000 (throttled). Monitoring index write throughput and consumer lag.

maria: thanks everyone — I'll keep this thread updated and close TKT-4321 after customer verifies. :pray:

omar: update ~30m later: reindex finished for that offset range. Reconciliation script linked ~2.3k spans to their requests. Spot-checked req_8f4c2a and spans now visible in UI.

elaine: Acme confirmed span visibility restored and closed the support case. :tada:

kevin: added a changelog note and linked PR/incident. Will add unit test for canonical header handling.

maria: closing thread — will attach postmortem draft when ready.
